Added finite per-profile retry/backoff policy for provider turns, logged retries, and validated with policy tests plus a full build.

Implemented randomized cooldown fallback for transient provider-capacity limits. Explicit provider retry/reset windows still take precedence, quota exhaustion remains fixed, and transient fallback now uses a 10-30s randomized refractory window with focused policy tests and successful build validation.

Implemented source-group refractory scheduling for non-hot wakes. Internal jobs and non-direct mail now wait behind a 10-30s randomized cooldown keyed by wake source group, while direct/private and urgent mail bypass the refractory window. Added policy coverage for jitter and hot/refractory classification and validated with tests plus build.

Implemented local event integration in agent-jobs with a durable fleet_local_events queue, CLI publish/peek/claim/complete/list commands, rebuild and verify projection support, stale event-claim recovery, and a focused lifecycle test. Also fixed the agent-jobs trailing-argument parsing bug so optional fifth arguments are read correctly.

Integrated agent-mail with channel subscription state from agent-state. Public broadcasts now map to chat:general, public ad-hoc recipients map to their channel name, unsubscribed channels suppress burst selection until resume_at elapses, and direct/urgent mail still bypasses filtering. Added focused transport tests and validated with tests plus full build.

Added explicit runtime status transition logic to agent-state. The set command now validates a fixed status vocabulary, rejects illegal jumps, and normalizes incompatible fields by state so persisted runtime state remains coherent. Added focused transition tests and validated with tests plus full build.
Added alarms and local events as wake sources, exposed alarm lifecycle commands, and shifted wake selection to agent-chosen claim-after-choice orchestration with deterministic fallback.
Added heartbeat requests on local and cloud unix socket servers, covered them with socket tests, and upgraded fleet status to perform live heartbeat checks instead of path-only inspection.
